context: Checks whether the final artifact follows the test-planning-process instructions from the published Ruby Core Skills plugin.

checklist.name: instruction-1
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: The first failing test MUST be identified explicitly in the plan before writing it.

checklist.name: instruction-2
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: All test data must be synthetic; never use real production values or API payloads in test plans.

checklist.name: instruction-3
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: **Request / API Boundary:** Use when verifying HTTP statuses, headers, query parsing, or JSON payload structures.

checklist.name: instruction-4
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: **Service / Business Boundary:** Use when validating domain invariants, complex calculations, or coordination between objects.

checklist.name: instruction-5
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: **Unit Boundary:** Use when verifying low-level calculations, state changes on a single object, or formatting logic.

checklist.name: instruction-6
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Run the skeleton as-is — it should fail (Red). Proceed to `tdd-process` to make it pass.
